title: Sing until doubt loses its room
summary: Sung Naam turns inner light on and shows the way. Bring the mind back to what is clear enough to keep.
takeaway: Bring the mind back to what is clear enough to keep.
lifeApplication: Before researching one more answer, repeat the clearest line you already trust until the breathing slows.

source.shortMeaning: Sung Naam turns inner light on and shows the way.
source.lifeApplication: When uncertainty crowds the head, sing until the way becomes visible again.

evidence.coreClaim: Sung Naam turns inner light on and shows the way.
evidence.turn: Remember this: when Naam is planted within, doubt loses its house.
evidence.practicalImplication: Before researching one more answer, repeat the clearest line you already trust until the breathing slows.
